messages.subject: Meridian - price and Unit 5
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We understand your client wants to revisit the price in light of the Unit 5 void and reletting risk. Our client is prepared to move from £14.75m to £14.25m, on the basis that the £75k roof retention is in addition and the overage stays at 30%. That's our client's best position.

Jonathan Vane, Castle & Vane LLP

messages.subject: FW: Meridian - price and Unit 5
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Helena,

Castle & Vane have come back at £14.25m plus the separate £75k roof retention, overage unchanged at 30%. That's a £500k reduction on the headline and reflects the void. My recommendation is to accept - it's a fair outcome and keeps us on timetable.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
